confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of local prices, not checked against live menus, listings or booking sites. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are least certain because July rates vary widely by season, platform and neighborhood. Cocktail and wine anchors were cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.3x beer, wine glass about 1.2x beer) since direct knowledge is weaker. FX value comes from RBA exchange-rate page excerpts returned by search, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Georgia sits at the Europe-Asia boundary, so Europe is the nearest region option. Tbilisi's everyday restaurant and budget lodging prices are reasoned against Eastern European and Balkan capitals such as Sofia, Belgrade and Tirana, with the South Caucasus capital Yerevan as a closer regional reference. Hotel anchors are set higher to reflect summer tourism demand in central Tbilisi.
